# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Blind, Mute, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | green |
| red | blue |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I am Blind. I have act(op='cut', position=1..5). Deaf will speak the bomb state to you. Check the manual, gesture the wire number to Deaf, and Deaf can speak it out loud for me to cut.

I am Mute. I hold the defusal manual, which maps the light color to the wire color that must be cut. However, I cannot see the bomb and cannot speak. Deaf sees the bomb and can speak, but has not taken their turn yet in Round 1 (the turn order is Blind, Mute, Deaf). 

Since any gesture I make right now would have no agreed meaning, I should wait for Deaf to speak what they see on the bomb (the light color and the wire colors/positions). Once Deaf speaks that information, I will look up the correct wire in the manual and gesture the wire number to Deaf.

```
wait()
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | green |
| red | blue |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Bomb visual state: Display shows 0. Light is yellow. 5 Wires: 1 green, 2 white, 3 red, 4 yellow, 5 blue. Mute, check the manual and gesture the instruction to me so I can speak it to Blind.

The defusal manual specifies that for a yellow light, the wire to cut is red:
- Light: yellow -> cut wire color: red.
According to Deaf's observation of the bomb:
- Wire 1: green
- Wire 2: white
- Wire 3: red
- Wire 4: yellow
- Wire 5: blue

Wire 3 is the red wire. Therefore, wire 3 must be cut. To convey the number 3 to Deaf unambiguously, I will signal three tally marks using the index finger gesture.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | green |
| red | blue |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Mute: I told Blind that your signal is 3 (wire 3 / red wire). If there is anything more specific, please gesture.
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

I must wait for Deaf to inspect the updated bomb state and speak what they see.

```
wait()
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | green |
| red | blue |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Wire 3 cut was correct! New state: Light is GREEN, Display is 0. Wires are now: 1 white, 2 yellow, 3 CUT, 4 blue, 5 green. Mute, check if we are fully defused or if there is another step. Gesture thumbs up if done, or gesture the next wire/step.

The manual states that for a green light, the cut wire color is green:
- Light: green -> cut wire color: green.

From Deaf's report of the new state:
- Wire 1: white
- Wire 2: yellow
- Wire 3: CUT
- Wire 4: blue
- Wire 5: green

Wire 5 is green. Using the same tally system as before, I will gesture five index fingers to Deaf to indicate wire 5.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | green |
| red | blue |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Mute: I told Blind to cut wire 5 (green).
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

I need to wait for Deaf to observe the updated bomb state and describe it.

```
wait()
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | green |
| red | blue |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Correct wire cut again! Updated state: Light is WHITE, Display is 0. Wires are now: 1 yellow, 2 blue, 3 CUT, 4 white, 5 CUT. Mute, what is the next step?

The defusal manual specifies that for a white light, the wire to cut is yellow:
- Light: white -> cut wire color: yellow.

Deaf reported the wires as:
- Wire 1: yellow
- Wire 2: blue
- Wire 3: CUT
- Wire 4: white
- Wire 5: CUT

Wire 1 is yellow. Using the same tally system, I will gesture one index finger to Deaf to indicate wire 1.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | green |
| red | blue |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Mute: Relayed wire 1 (yellow) to Blind.
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The bomb has changed again. I will wait for Deaf to observe and report the new state.

```
wait()
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | white |
| green | green |
| red | blue |
| white | yellow |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Correct wire cut! Updated state: Light is RED, Display is 0. Wires: 1 CUT, 2 white, 3 CUT, 4 blue, 5 CUT. Mute, what is the next step?

I need to signal wire 4 to Deaf. According to the manual, when the light is red, the wire to cut is blue. Wire 4 is blue. I will gesture four index fingers to indicate wire 4.

```
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "☝", "☝", "☝"])
```
